buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC Subject- Additional Terms AND Conditions in addition to ibid terms AND conditions mentioned in the bid document which are as below a. The Bidder should have minimum 5 years of experience in providing services of outsourcing of M anpower in Central-State Government Departments with at least one year of experience of workin g in the same field in Courts-Tribunals, copy of the work orders and Registration Certificate of Com pany-Firm (as applicable) to be uploaded. b. Minimum average annual turnover of the bidder during the last three Financial Years i.e FY- 2023- 24,FY- 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 should be Rs. 350 Lakh or above. Copy of audited balance sheets o r latest certificate of Chartered Accountant to be uploaded. c. The Bidder Net worth should be positive in last three financial years and should be solvent to the extent of minimum 1.5 crores or above. A latest solvency certificate from any Nationalized Bank to be uploaded (latest, not older than three months from the date of publish of bid). d. The bidder must have executed at least five (05) such orders of providing manpower services of c ontract value more than Rs. 1 Crore in any central-state Government Department (s) in similar fiel d i.e. manpower “Unskilled- Semi skilled-Skilled”. Copy of work orders to be uploaded. e. The Office of the bidder must be located in Delhi-NCR region. Copy of valid rent agreement or ow nership document to be uploaded. f. The Bidder should have strength of more than 50 or above employees on rolls, copies of current EPF- ESIC return or ECR to be submit to prove the authenticity for the last quarter & GSTR 3B of The last qu arter i.e. from January to March,2025. g. Documents requested in ATC must be uploaded in ATC Document specific column only [at Additional Doc.1 or at Certificate (requested in ATC)]. h. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation; court receivership or si milar proceedings and should not be bankrupt. An undertaking duly Notarized on Rs. 100 stam p paper (date should be after date of publishing the bid) to be uploaded (In absence of the undert aking on Stamp paper the bid(s) are likely to be rejected and no further opportunity will be pr ovided to bidder for submission of any documents).The bidder should not have ever been bl acklisted by any State or Central Government Department -PSU - Agency in the past for breach of contract, fraudulent, unethical or corrupt business practices. An Affidavit-declaration on Rs. 100 st amp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted from any Government agency or PSU undertaki ng (In absence of the undertaking on Stamp paper the bid(s) are likely to be rejected and no furthe r opportunity will be provided to bidder for submission of any documents. i. Option Clause: The purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the overall quantity of m anpower upto 25 PERCENT “inter-alia” at the time of placement of order or during the period of the contract. The number of required manpower under each of categories is indicative and subject to c hange, however total number of manpower would not exceed - reduce by 25 PERCENT.Contd..P2 j. The existing all manpower will be retained by the buyer and if needed to change are subject to b uyer, hence, Bidders are to accept the orders accordingly. If replacement of manpower is needed “ due to misconduct-misbehaviour on the part of manpower which will not be tolerated”. Hence, to b e replaced within 3 working days. k. The bidder must submit the copy of Registration Certificate of Establishment issued by Deptt. Of labour or Labour License. Copy of ISO 9001:2015 must also be uploaded. l. The service provider will also ensure that the payment-remuneration to the deployed manpower in this Tribunal are paid on or before 7th day of the every month and the bill are to submitted to this office latest by 12th of every month with the copies of all statu tory paid challan. Subsequently, Tribunal will endeavour to make reimbursement at the earliest on or before 15th of every month, subject of completeness of statutory docume nts.

m. Bidder must have dedicated telephone numbers for service support certificate in Manpower: Bid der must have valid - ISO certificate in supply of Manpower. n. GeM Star rating: Star rating of GEM not below than 4.5. “upload relevant snap of GeM portal”. o. The Period of contract is for one year and extendable for further one year “or the period as per G eM provision, subject to satisfaction of the authorities of this Tribunal “i.e. Mahanadi WDT” on sam e terms & conditions including rate. “Minimum wages applicable or as amended from time to time by the Govt.”. p. Bidder should provide all the relevant required documents in the bid, no other opportunity will be provided for submission of documents. q. The bidder shall furnish ePBG as applicable as per bid’s terms and conditions 3% [3PERCENT] of t he one year value of contract in form of fixed deposit receipt-BG in the name of PAO MoWR, New D elhi. r. The performance of the contract shall be reviewed periodically. Any complaint of non-performan ce, contract may be terminated by the Department by giving one month’ s notice. s. The bidders must quote service charges greater than or equal to 4.99 Percent Vendor submitting - quoting service charges less than 4.99 percent will be summarily rejected. In case of multiple ve ndors offering the same rate resulting to multiple “L-1” in financial bid opening, the GeM procedure will be followed. Registrar .
